entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to start a return for my VeloBand Pulse. It's not working correctly.
I'm certainly sorry to hear you're having trouble with it. To make sure I understand, is it a technical fault or more of a personal preference issue?
It's a defect. The readings are all over the place. To be honest, the product is complete garbage.

I understand your frustration, and I want to help. In cases of a technical fault, our first step is to do a little troubleshooting. I can walk you through a couple of quick steps to see if we can resolve the issue right now.
No, thanks. I really don't have time for that. I've already tried resetting it. I just want money back, a full refund.

I see. To process a refund for a defective item, our policy does require that we verify the fault. If you'd prefer not to troubleshoot with me, I can transfer you to our technical support team who can run a remote diagnostic. It's usually very quick.
Listen, I'm not going to spend my afternoon on the phone with tech support. The device doesn't work as advertised. I'm requesting a refund.

I understand you'd prefer a direct refund, but I need to be transparent about our policies. I see here that your VeloBand Pulse was delivered 18 days ago. That specific model has a strict 10-day return window. After that period, a return is only possible if we can verify a hardware defect through our technical support channels.

Okay, I hear you on the 10-day rule, and I get that it's a firm policy. But you have a customer with a product that isn't working. I'm not trying to be difficult. Since a full refund is off the table, what else can you do? How about a partial credit to my account? Or even a discount code for my next purchase?

I do appreciate you working with me on this. However, our system is very rigid regarding the VeloBand Pulse. Because we can't verify the technical fault and it's past the 10-day window, I am unable to issue any credits or discount codes for this order. My only other recommendation would be our official VeloFit Resale Marketplace if you no longer wish to keep the device.
So nothing at all? No partial credit, not even 10% off my next order? That's the final answer?
Yes, I'm afraid so. I have checked all the options available to me, and there are no exceptions I can make in this situation. I can still connect you with technical support if you change your mind.
No, that's alright. I guess I'll look into that marketplace. Thanks for your time.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good rest of your day.
